target: PI 2026-10-27 (docs/DECISIONS.md:93-98, :110-117(c)): whole-face mu_req as the first-line slip-out check, 'local partial slip does not count'; frictional check only on selected designs, 6 directions x 3 cycles (DECISIONS.md:34)
claim: The whole-face limit is a single-load-state, rigid-body test. It cannot see migration that builds up from LOCAL slip over many load cycles while the whole-face ratio stays below mu. This mechanism is documented in engineering. Bolted joints loosen under transverse cyclic load through the piling up of localised slip, without gross slip (Pai & Hess 2002). Bearing rings 'creep' (walk) in their seats under rolling loads through a travelling slip wave, at loads below the gross-slip limit. The cage has the same ingredients: partial slip is common (round 2: tied h15 runs show slip_area_frac 0.25-0.8 at mu 0.35, F-0015), the load direction changes from cycle to cycle, and the 6 physio directions apply moments that move the pressure centre around. A designer optimising mu_req will push the whole-face ratio toward the limit while leaving large local-slip zones, which is exactly the regime where walking happens. The frictional check that could see it runs 3 cycles on selected designs only, while the support period is >= 16 weeks (roughly 10^5-10^6 neck motion cycles; unverified estimate). A ratcheting rate small enough to pass after 3 cycles can still add up to millimetres. Also, PI decision (c) says 'local partial slip does not count as failure', but no rule bounds the per-cycle increment of the rigid-body part, so a slow walk is legal by definition.
evidence: Literature: Pai N.G., Hess D.P. (2002) 'Three-dimensional finite element analysis of threaded fastener loosening due to dynamic shear load', Engineering Failure Analysis 9(4):383-402 (loosening by accumulated localised slip below gross slip). Bearing creep under rolling-element load: e.g. US patent 9995343B2 'Rolling bearing' (outer-ring creep from load-induced ring deformation), and WCECS 2013 pp.1030-1035 (iaeng.org) - engineering sources, not peer-reviewed biomechanics; the transfer to a cage-endplate interface is an argument by analogy, unverified for this geometry. Project numbers: partial slip fractions 0.25-0.8 (old repo physio_fix/p062_gpu2/summary.json, cited in F-0015); 3 cycles: DECISIONS.md:34; whole-face definition: DECISIONS.md:115-117. The cycle count for 16 weeks is not sourced (unverified).
how_to_reproduce: Proposed test, not yet run (needs the frictional GPU path, which has no gate, F-0023): p062 with real friction mu 0.3, 6 directions x 30 cycles, record the rigid-body translation at the end of each cycle; fit the per-cycle increment after cycle 3; extrapolate to 1e5 cycles. Pass only if the increment is below solver noise (gate 1d level) or the extrapolation stays < 0.5 mm posterior.

fix_options.option: Add a ratcheting rule: the rigid-body migration increment per cycle over cycles 2-3 (or 2-10), extrapolated to the support period, must stay below the S9 limits; run it on every promoted design, not only selected ones.
fix_options.risk: needs solver creep below the physical rate (F-0015: penalty-dependent numerical creep could dominate)

fix_options.option: Use mu_req only as a screen with a margin (e.g. promote only if mu_req <= 0.6 x 0.3) and require the frictional cyclic run for the final ranking.
fix_options.risk: margin is a guess until option 1 calibrates it

fix_options.option: Literature search (safety guard) on cage / implant migration under cyclic loading below the slip limit (e.g. intervertebral cage subsidence / migration bench tests, ASTM F2267 / F2077 cyclic protocols) to set the cycle count and acceptable rate.

summary_zh: PI 決定先用「整個接觸面當成一體」的摩擦需求值來判斷會不會滑出，並規定接觸面局部的小滑動不算失敗。問題是：這個方法只看單一受力瞬間，看不到「每次一點點、反覆累積」的移動。工程上這種現象有文獻記載：螺栓在反覆側向受力下，會因為局部小滑動累積而鬆脫，整體並沒有滑動（Pai 與 Hess 2002 年，Engineering Failure Analysis 期刊）；軸承外環在負載下也會慢慢沿著座孔「走動」。cage 也具備這些條件：模擬顯示接觸面有 25% 到 80% 在局部滑動，受力方向每次都在變。設計者若把摩擦需求值壓到剛好低於上限，反而會停在最容易累積移動的狀態。能看到這種累積的真實摩擦模擬，目前只跑 3 個循環、而且只跑少數設計；但支撐期至少 16 週，頸部活動次數大約是數十萬次（此數字為估計，尚未查證）。建議：加上「每個循環的移動增量，外推到支撐期，仍需低於上限」的規則，並對每個入選設計都檢查。
